g.text: Calibrating German rooftop PV without a single mapped quadrat

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c9bda4

g.text: Germany has no exhaustively mapped calibration boxes, so the usual coverage-ratio route is shut. MaStR is complete instead. (1) It publishes

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c9bda4

g.text: coordinates only at and above 30 kWp, so 42.1 of the 49.0 GWp below the detection floor can never be located, which is why training on coordinates

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c9bda4

g.text: made the estimate worse. (2) The calibration is one constant, kWp per credited roof area, fitted against the register per municipality. (3)

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c9bda4

g.text: Supervising with per-municipality COUNTS fixes the label problem, but on a representative sample it only ties multiplying roof area by a constant.
